name: winccoa-vscode-logviewer
description: LogViewer for WinCC OA - View and analyze log files in real-time
author: RichardJanisch

languageModelTools.name: logviewer_query_logs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Query log events with filters (severity, time range, search pattern). Returns recent log events matching the criteria. Use when the user asks about logs, errors, warnings, or specific events in WinCC OA.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Query and filter WinCC OA log events

severity.description: Filter by severity: 'INFO', 'WARNING', 'FATAL', 'SEVERE', 'DEBUG', or array of severities

searchPattern.description: Search pattern to match in message, scope, or identifier (case-insensitive)

lastMinutes.description: Only show events from the last N minutes

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

languageModelTools.name: logviewer_get_recent_errors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the last N error/warning events from WinCC OA logs. Use when the user asks about recent errors, problems, or issues in the system.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get recent errors and warnings from WinCC OA

limit.description: Number of recent errors to return (default: 10)

languageModelTools.name: logviewer_search_pattern
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for a specific pattern in log messages. Use when the user wants to find specific text, error codes, or patterns in the logs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search for specific patterns in WinCC OA logs

pattern.description: Search pattern to find in logs

caseSensitive.description: Whether search should be case-sensitive (default: false)

languageModelTools.name: logviewer_get_by_severity
languageModelTools.displayName: Get WinCC OA Logs by Severity
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get all events for a specific severity level (INFO, WARNING, FATAL, SEVERE, DEBUG). Use when the user asks about all warnings, all errors, or debug messages.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Filter WinCC OA logs by severity level

enumDescriptions: Use a static path configured in settings
Automatically detect from selected WinCC OA project (requires Core extension)
winccoaLogviewer.logPathSource.description: How to determine the log directory path

winccoaLogviewer.staticLogPath.description: Static log directory path (used when logPathSource is 'static'). Example: C:\WinCC_OA\MyProject\log or /opt/WinCC_OA/MyProject/log

winccoaLogviewer.background.enabled.description: Enable background log monitoring (logs are collected even when LogViewer panel is closed)

winccoaLogviewer.background.maxEvents.description: Maximum number of log events to keep in background buffer (ringbuffer)

winccoaLogviewer.autoClearOnScriptExecut.description: Automatically clear logs when a WinCC OA script is executed via Script Actions extension

scripts.ci:integration: npm ci && cd webview && npm ci && cd .. && npm run compile && npm run test:integration
scripts.clean:out-tests: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('out/test',{ recursive:true, force:true, maxRetries:10, retryDelay:200 })}catch(e){console.warn('clean:out-tests skipped:', e.message)}"
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.style-check: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:integration:coverage
scripts.test:integration:coverage: npm run compile:tsc && npm run clean:coverage:integrationTests && vscode-test --label integrationTests --coverage --coverage-output coverage/integrationTests --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-reporter html --coverage-reporter json-summary --coverage-reporter text-summary
scripts.test:unit:coverage: npm run compile:tsc && npm run clean:coverage:unitTests && vscode-test --label unitTests --coverage --coverage-output coverage/unitTests --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-reporter html --coverage-reporter json-summary --coverage-reporter text-summary
